summary_1line: Duryodhana and Satyaki clash despite recalling childhood friendship, while Drona devastates the Pandava forces and Krishna proposes deceiving him about Ashwatthaman’s death.

image_candidates.scene_text: Satyaki and Duryodhana stand on their chariots under a storm of arrows, their shafts filling the sky as the armies roar around them.
Bhima smashes Karna’s chariot, breaking a wheel while Karna stands firm on the crippled car like a mountain amid battle.
Sages appear in the sky before the blazing Drona, urging him to lay down his weapons while the battlefield below is strewn with slain warriors.
